# Toggle

A button that stays pressed or not.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## See it live

<div class="odv-live"><span class="odv-wait">Start Storybook to see it live: <code>npm run storybook</code></span><iframe src="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-toggle--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive;mode:light" title="Toggle examples in Storybook" loading="lazy"></iframe><div class="bar"><span>Live from Storybook</span><a href="http://localhost:6006/?path=/docs/components-toggle--docs">Open Toggle in Storybook</a><a href="http://localhost:6006/iframe.html?id=components-toggle--examples&viewMode=story&globals=scheme:brand-expressive;mode:dark">See it in dark</a></div></div>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** A mode turned on and off in place. Not as a one-off action; button does that.

- **Use it when:** Turning a mode or format on and off in a toolbar, such as bold.
- **Not when:** A setting saved at once (switch), or a one-off action (button).

Instead:

- [Switch](./switch.md): A setting.
- [Button](./button.md): A one-off action.
- [Toggle group](./toggle-group.md): Several toggles together.

## Why it works this way

Toggle looks the way it does because of 6 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Toggle, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-components-roles"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>Which component families does it need?</b><code>components.roles</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Core, plus media</div><p>Campaigns lead with media and big sections.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Toggle</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>default</b>: Sections lead with media and color blocks, not toolbars; a toggle with no border is lost on vivid color.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Toggle decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-color-values"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How saturated is the palette?</b><code>color.values</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Vivid</div><p>Vivid color is the brand.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Toggle</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>default</b>: Sections lead with media and color blocks, not toolbars; a toggle with no border is lost on vivid color.</span></li><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>outline</b>: A pill with a border, so the toggle reads as a control on vivid color.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Item: outline</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Toggle decisions would reopen</small><p>and 2 answers that follow from it: <b>Two-tone</b>, <b>Brand color</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-shape-values"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What should control corners say?</b><code>shape.values</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Pill</div><p>Pill controls feel playful.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Toggle</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>outline</b>: A pill with a border, so the toggle reads as a control on vivid color.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Toggle decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-accessibility-values"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the smallest target?</b><code>accessibility.values</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Touch size</div><p>Visitors come from social posts on phones.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Toggle</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: Every toggle, at touch size: phones first.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>sm</b>: Phones first: no compact controls.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: default</code> <code>Button: compact</code> <code>Button: icon</code> <code>Field: horizontal</code> <code>Input group: inline-end</code> <code>Item: default</code> <code>Item: sm</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Toggle decisions would reopen</small><p>and 1 answer that follow from it: <b>Those and pressed</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-tasks-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How often do people repeat actions?</b><code>tasks.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Rarely</div><p>One action: sign up.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Toggle</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>lg</b>: Large is for the one call to action per section, and a toggle is not that action.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Alert: default</code> <code>Input group: block-start</code> <code>Input group: block-end</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Toggle decision would reopen</small><p>and 2 answers that follow from it: <b>Three</b>, <b>Only what today's screens use</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-outcomes-q1"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>Which outcome matters most?</b><code>outcomes.q1</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Engagement</div><p>Engagement and sign-ups.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Toggle</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>lg</b>: Large is for the one call to action per section, and a toggle is not that action.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: primary</code> <code>Button: large</code> <code>Badge: warning</code> <code>Toast: success</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Toggle decision would reopen</small><p>and 6 answers that follow from it: <b>A few minutes</b>, <b>Brand moments</b>, <b>Hero and launch moments</b>, and 3 more.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Space or Enter presses it. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It says whether it is pressed. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add toggle
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
